spans.s:
mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्)
Inclined or addicted to falling repeatedly.
m. (-षन्)
A bird.
E.
पत to come down, in the desiderative form, and शतृ participial aff.

f. (-षा)
Wish or inclination to come down, to fall, &c.
E.
पत to fall, desid. form, अङ् and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Disposed to fall or descend.
m. (-षुः)
A bird.
E.
पत to fall, desid. form, उ aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to purify.
E.
पू to be pure, desid. v., उ aff.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्)
Thirsty, thirsting.
E.
पा to drink, desid. v., शतृ aff.

f. (-सा)
Thirst.
E.
पा to drink in the desiderative form, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Thirsty, athirst.
E.
पिपासा thirst, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु)
Thirsty, athirst.
E.
पा to drink, desid. form, and उ aff.

f. (-की)
The twelfth of the month Vaiśākha, when giving away water is an act of merit.
E.
पिपीतक the name of a Brahman, said to have instituted the rite, ङीष् aff.

m. (-कः)
A large black ant.
f. (-लिका)
The common small red ant.
E.
पील to stop, repeated, कन् aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to ask.
E.
प्रच्छ to ask, desid. v., उ aff.

m. (-लः)
1 The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
2 A bird.
3 The sleeve of a jacket or coat.
n. (-लं)
Water.
f. (-ली)
Longpepper.
E.
(-पा) to preserve, aff. कलच्, and the root reiterated.

n. (-लं)
The root of long-pepper.
E.
पिप्पली, and मल the root.

f. (-का)
The tartar of the teeth.
E.
पाय to increase, aff. इक, deriv. irr.

m. (-प्लुः)
A freckle, a mark.
E.
अपि certainly, प्लुष to burn or inflame, aff. डु.
